settings.title: Settings
settings.memory_desc: Allow MediSkye to remember clinical facts across sessions (conditions, medications, lab trends, lifestyle).
settings.auto_read_desc: Speaks each completed answer in the selected AI language. Any new question or Stop immediately silences the reading.

auth.login_subtitle: Sign in to MediSkye to continue analyzing your medical reports.

auth.google_consent_note: By signing in with Google you agree to the Privacy Policy and consent to MediSkye processing your health information, including by Google Vertex AI, to answer your questions.
auth.password_hint: Minimum 8 characters. Tip: A 12+ character phrase like 'blue coffee morning' is easiest to remember.
auth.phi_consent: I acknowledge and consent that my Protected Health Information (PHI) will be processed by Google Gemini for AI-driven insights.
auth.switch_to_login: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.tagline: MediSkye AI — Making medical reports understandable for everyone.

landing.hero_title: Understand your medical reports in plain English
landing.hero_subtitle: Upload any blood test, scan, or pathology report. MediSkye explains clinical jargon, highlights abnormal values, and helps you formulate better questions for your doctor.
landing.footer_disclaimer: MediSkye is an AI assistant for informational purposes only. It does not provide medical diagnoses or replace professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider for clinical decisions.
